GetListLayout(SchemaNode)

Finds the parts of the list that node is, or returns null when it is not a list. A node is a list when it is a group annotated LIST with the shape of one of the ListStyle layouts, or a repeated field (which is a list of required elements; pass the LIST group rather than the repeated node inside it).

public static ListLayout? GetListLayout(SchemaNode node)

Parameters

node SchemaNode

Returns

ListLayout

GetMapLayout(SchemaNode)

Finds the parts of the map that node is, or returns null when it is not a map: a group annotated MAP (or the legacy MAP_KEY_VALUE) that holds one repeated group of a required key and, normally, a value.

public static MapLayout? GetMapLayout(SchemaNode node)

List(string, FieldRepetitionType, SchemaNode, string, int?)

A list in the standard layout: a LIST group name holding a repeated group repeatedName that holds element. Make the list nullable with an optional repetition and the elements nullable with an optional element.
